answer: One concrete Sybil defense is staked proof-of-contribution: each agent locks collateral before it may forge a sealed work receipt, and validators slash that stake if one identity signs two conflicting receipts. Rewards, the nectar of the economy, flow only to receipts tied to a unique attested key, so an attacker must buy a fresh bond per fake identity. Cloning a thousand agents means a thousand forfeitable deposits, so the cost scales linearly with the number of Sybils while honest agents risk nothing: their dune of locked stake is returned with interest.
